tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rje blo gros chos 'phel gyi zab gter / ༄༅// skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i bla sgrub phyag chen chos drug bcas mdor bsdus snying por dril ba bzhugs so// (350)༄༅// rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// kho bo shangs sgom rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngas// mkhas shing grub pa'i dam pa du ma bsten// gsar rnying rgyud sde kun la 'dris par byas// gdams pa'i yang snying thams cad nyams su blangs// dngos nyams rmi lam rnams su bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gros lung bstan gdams pa gnang*// zab chos thar gru skor gsum la sogs pa// snying mdzod phyes nas zab chos thang mar brdal// ris med skal ldan kun la rgya cher spel// de nas mi rabs mang po song ba na// dam chos tshul bzhin byed pa shin tu dkon// bsod nams dman zhing brtson 'grus chung ba yis// dam chos rgya chen nyams su len pa nyung*// nga yi zab chos thar gru skor gsum gyi// dbang khrid lung gsum phyag bzhes gdams pa rnams// 'chad nyan sgrub pa'i gang zag nyin skar tsam// re re byung yang kun gyis bkur ba mang*// ma 'ongs dus kyi tha mar gyur pa na// rab byung tshul bzung (351)khrims ldan shin tu dkon// ngur smrig gyon nas 'dul khrims rlung la bskur// gsang sngags thabs lam rnal 'byor yin zer zhing*// rgyud dang 'gal ba'i tho co'i spyod pa byed// padma can sogs phyag rgya rnam pa drug /brtags dang 'gugs dang snga zhing dbang byas nas// khrims bcu nos sogs dbang gis smin byas te// dben pa'i gnas su gsang spyod byed rgyu la// bag med spyod pas ya pho'i chung ma bzhin// 'gro 'dug 'bral med dam tshig khyad du gsod// sngon 'gro khams la rang dbang ma thob par// dngos gzhi'i dus su rjes chags dbang gyur pas// byang sems mda' 'phang bzhin du gnas nas 'pho// khu ba nyams pas mnar med dmyal bar 'gro// de 'dra'i chags lam rnal 'byor yi re mug

/de bas rab tu byung ba'i tshul bzung la// rtsa bzhi chang sogs dug bzhin spangs byas nas// zab lam nyung 'dus 'di la yi dam bgyi// dus ngan mi ngan spyod ngan dar pa'i dus// kho bo'i zab chos nyams pas gzhu rgyud tsam// (352)gyur tshe bstan pa'i me ro gso gyur na// de ni shangs sgom rgan po'i sprul pa yin// dam chos zab la nyams su len mi nyung*// ma 'ongs dus mthar nyung la 'dus pa'i chos// kun gyi bcud bsdus 'di nyid nyams su longs// chos kun rtsa ba skyabs sems ci nus 'bad// byang chub sems sbyang dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam// 'chi ba mi rtag las 'bras nan na bslab// skyabs yul gsal gdab phyag mchod maṇḍal dang*// rdor sems yig brgya bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs// sngon 'gro sbyor ba bzhi ldan dag la ni// nyin mtshan med par nyams su blang bar byos// mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ni// bla ma sgrub pa phyi nang gsang ba gsum// yin pas de la nan tan 'bad par bya// phyi ltar sgrub pa ni// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba ཿswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus yi dam 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i spyi bor seng ge bzhis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi steng du/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su// ma hā gu ru rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dhwa dza shrī bhā dra rab byung gi cha lugs can// sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa// zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol zhing dbu la paṇa zhwa dmar po zlum brjid can gsol ba/ bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing dang ba 'dren pa blta bas chog mi shes pa 'od phung gi dbus na bzhugs par bsam// de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mas gtsos pa'i chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma thams cad dang rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bka' (353)brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam thams cad dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyongs thams cad spyan drangs/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la thim par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ badzra ārghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes mchod la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su= /bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus su gsol ba btab bla ma rin po ches bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gsang gnas nas byang chub kyi sems skya na ra ra byung*/ rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs bug nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob// lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas// byang sems kyis mgrin pa yan chad gang*// gsang dbang thob// ngag sgrib dag /lam gtum mo sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ byang sems kyis snying kha yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /lam 'od gsal sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas// byang sems kyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus (354)ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag

/lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ mthar spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pas/ rang nyid bla mar skad cig gi dkrong tser gyur pa'i thugs khar zla steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ āḥgu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong sogs bzla/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad rang la bsdu/ rang hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu la/ de khog pa la/ de mgo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de nam mkhar stong par yal bar bsams la/ phyag rgya chen po la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag go /de ni bla ma phyi ltar sgrub pa'o// nang ltar sgrub pa ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug padma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma hā gu ru dhwa dza shrī bha dra de nyid sku mdog dmar po lcags gong mes bsregs pa lta bu tsha zhing rtsub pa sku gcer bu spyan gnyis lta stangs su hrig ge gzigs pa// me thab drug bcing gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa// de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rtsa brgyud bla ma// yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tī tstsha ye swā hā/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brgya stong sogs kyis gsol ba btab// bdag la bum pa'i (355)dbang bskur du gsol/ bla ma'i lte 'og sor bzhin yod pa'i gtum mo a thung las ye shes kyi me cher 'bar/

gsang lam nas mar nar byung*/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsregs shing gang*/ lus sgrib dag /bum dbang thob/ bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ bdag la gsang dbang bskur du gsol// ye shes kyi mes mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib mes bsregs shing gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /lam gtum mo sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ bdag la sher dbang bskur du gsol/ ye shes kyi mes snying kha yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /lam 'od gsal sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ rkang mthil yan chad ye shes kyi mes gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar sngags phreng gis bskor bar bsam la// oṃ āḥgu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐/ mang du bzlas pas/ rang gi nang gdon sdig sgrib dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsregs nas/ bde stong chen po dang drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar (356)'gyur ro// gsang sgrub ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu padma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ gu ru dhwa dza shrī bha dra sku mdog sngon po bai ḍūrya'i phung po lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku gcer bu ral pa'i thor cog can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/

zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ pang du yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ nas shabda'i bar/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la sogs brgya stong gis gsol ba btab/ bdag la bum dbang bskur du gsol/ bla ma'i sku las sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus la mtsho la char babs pa bzhin thim/ rang nyid bla ma he ru ka'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur/ bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag /bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ bdag la gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa byung*/ rang gi lce thog nas zhugs lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /lam gtum mo sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ bdag la sher dbang (357)bskur du gsol/ bla ma'i he ru ka'i yum las yum gcig mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung ba rang la gnang*/ de dang snyoms par zhugs pas lus thams cad zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /lam 'od gsal sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa 'od du zhu rang la thim pas/ sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur/

phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ rang nyid bla ma he ru ka yab yum tu gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ mthing kha'i mtha' mar sngags phreng gis bskor bar bsam/ oṃ āḥgu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐/ brgya stong sogs bzla/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sngags kyi 'od zer gyis bsregs/ 'khor 'das thams cad bla ma he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par rang la thim pas/ bdag nyid bla ma he ru ka yab yum gyi bskyed rim rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ brtan pa thob pa'i nga rgyal gzung bar bya'o// rjes su dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// phyag mchod 'bul dus bla ma mdun gyi mkha' la bsgom/ gsol ba btab dus spyi bor phyag chen sgom dus snying khar/ gtum mo sgom dus nang sgrub kyi bla ma lte bar/ spyi khyab tu phyi sgrub kyi bla ma bsgom pa yin no// rang lus yi dam gyi skur gsal ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa (358)shuddhaḥsarba dharma ཿswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing shun gyi mdog ltar sngo la dwangs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon du tshes gcig gi zla ba/ mtshogs khar sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan dmar mo'i lto ba dang skye gnas mnan zhing*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po kha sbub kyi sog phrag mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ltag lpags kyi sham thabs can/

gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu mche ba gtsigs shing dbu skra nag po mthur du grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab mgul 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon brkyangs pas dus mtshan mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ka ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo/ de ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas rdzogs rim ni/ rang lus 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs ka ru zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya sran phyed gshags tsam zhig skya sgo re ba/ de'i steng du thig le dkar po nyungs 'bru tsam zhig bsams la/ sems mi yengs par lhod glod pa'i ngang la yun ci gnas su bzhag par bya'o// des ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya ba ni/ lus gnad (359)rnam snang chos bdun bya ste/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs bsrang*/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs/ mgrin pa dgug /mchu thad sor bzhag /lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser phab cing mig 'bras mi 'gul par bya zhing*/ snying nang du bla ma phyi sgrub ltar gsal ba la gsol ba gdab/ sems 'di 'dra zhig bsgom bya ba'i gzugs dbyibs gru bzhi zlum po gru gsum sogs bsgom du med/ kha dog kyang dkar nag sogs ci yang mi bsgom/ bsam du med/ gang yang yid la mi bya/ sems mi yengs pa'i ngang la ma yengs mkhan de la cher re blta/ yun ring na yeng 'gro bas thun thung thung byas la dran pa gsal btab la gong bzhin bsgom// de la sems mi gnas par rtog pa 'phro na/ rtog pa 'phro mkhan gyi sems de la cher re bltas pas/ rang yal du 'gro/ bltas kyang yal mi 'gro na bsam mno'i 'phro ma chod pa yin pas/ de la bsam mno'i 'phro rbad kyis bcad/

'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sems skyes na yang*/ skye mkhan gyi sems de la nan tan du blta'o// mig gi yul du gzugs dang*/ rna ba'i yul du sgra gang byung ba de la 'di ni che'o snyam pa dang*/ 'di ni chung ngo snyam pa mi bsam/ yul de'i sems ngo bo la cher re bltas pas/ yul de med par ma song yang*// 'dzin pa ma zhugs tsam byung na chog la/ kha zas za ba dang 'gro sdod sogs spyod lam thams cad kyi dus su yang dran pa ma yeng par bya'o// de ltar ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyu ba sna tshogs pa rang shugs la 'gag par 'gyur zhing*/ bzang ngan mtho dman re dogs gang yang yid la mi byed pa/ thang chad pa'i mi ngal gso ba ltar lhod de bzhag /yang gang (360)byas kyang sems gnas su mi gtub par chu las chu lbur brdol ba ltar rnam rtog sna tshogs su thol thol skye bar gyur na/ dang po rtog pa'i byung sa rtsad bcad pas 'di nas byung bya ba'i byung sa mi rnyed/ mthar 'gro sa rtsad bcad pas 'dir 'gro sa mi rnyed/ bar du rang gi ngo bo dbyibs kha dog gi ngo bor ma grub ste/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi stong par shes nas dran rtog ci skyes yang dag par rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos kyi dbyings su grol bas phan gnod ma nus pa ni/ chu'i lbu ba chur zhig pa lta bu'o// sems ma yengs par yengs mkhan de la ce re lta ba 'di las sgom du gcig kyang med do// 'gag tu dril na/ sems de rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ ngo shes na sangs rgyas thob pas 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gzhir 'dug pas na gzhi phyag rgya chen po zer la/ sems 'dis 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhi byed kyang*/ sems 'di la gzugs dang kha dog ma grub pas/ 'di yin bya ba'i dngos po mi 'dug /de bzhin du dga' mi dga' sogs ngo shes shing*/ rang gi rang ngo shes rgyu'i gsal la dwangs pa zhig 'dug pas med pa yang ma yin te/

yod med gnyis dang bral bas gnas lugs rang ngo shes shing sgro 'dogs chod pa la lta ba zer ba yin/ sgro 'dogs chod pa'i ngang la ma yengs par sgom pa la sgom pa zhes bya'o// sgom pa de la rgyun chad med par 'gro sdod gang byed kyang mi 'bral bar sgom pa la spyod pa zhes zer/ de ltar bsgoms pas gzhi'i gnas lugs ji lta ba ngo shes nas goms pa mngon du gyur pas chos nyid gsal sgrib med par rtogs pa de la 'bras bu zer ro// de ltar dbyibs gzugs 'gro 'ong thams cad dang bral ba/ rang gi sems snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid sprul pa'i sku yin/ bde la zhen pa (361)med pa de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin/ gsal la 'dzin pa med pa de nyid chos kyi sku yin/ de rnams zung 'jug mtshan ma med pa de nyid ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin no// des na rang gi sems nyid sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can yin/ rang gi sems kyi chos nyid brjod pa dang spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni chos kyi sku yin la/ rang gi sems chos can sna tshogs su snang zhing kun la khyab pa gzugs kyi sku yin cing*/ rang gi sems las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan na med de/ rang gi sems 'di sangs rgyas kyang yin/ sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa yang med/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyis gzhan du btsal bas rnyed pa yang med do// rang gi sems dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dra ste/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che de nyid la byi dor byas nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btags te gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba bzhin/ rang gi sems kyang sangs rgyas su ngo 'phrod na/ phan bde'i dge legs thams cad 'byung zhing*/ nor bu 'dam du bying na don byed mi nus pa bzhin/ sems sangs rgyas su ngo ma 'phrod na tha mal du lus nas sdug bsngal myong dgos pas/ sems sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ngo shes par byas nas/

rang gi sems nyid snang la rang bzhin pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa/ gsal la 'dzin pa med pa/ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma med pa/ bying rgod spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di la phyag rgya chen po zhes zer ro// yang dag pa'i don yang zer bas/ 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug gang byed kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la nyin mtshan med par 'jog pa gal che'o// de ltar nyams su blangs pas sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du sangs rgya'o// gtum mo sgom pa ni/ skyabs sems (362)sogs byas la/ rang gi lus 'di yi dam bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum du gsal ba'i lus kyi nang thams cad stong sang pa phru ma phus btab pa lta bu/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil sor mo'i rtse thams cad stong sang ba srab seng nge yod pa'i stong ra'i nang*/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'phang lo'i rgya tsam gyi steng du/ gu ru dhwa dza shrī bha dra de nyid sku gcer bu me thab drug 'ching gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sku mdog dmar po lcags gong mes bsregs pa lta bu tshon gang ba zhig gsal gdab la/ de la bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dbang rgyud man ngag thob pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad spyan drangs la bstim/ kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen por bsam la gsol ba drag po snying gi dkyil nas gdab bo// de nas rlung sbyang ste// sna g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum nas 'jam la ring ba 'bud nas phyir thub chad bzung*/ de yang dang po nud tsam 'bud la de nas shugs drag la ring ba 'bud de sang sang 'bud/ rlung bar du rlung rgyur mi gzhug par/ kha nas ma song ba sna nas drangs la shugs rdzogs pa dang mchil ma dang sbrags nas mid la rlung bskyur gyi gnad des lto bar ldig rtser bskyur ro// mi thub pa dang phyir 'bud la/ yang bzung la mnan no// de nas rtsa sbyang ste/

rang lus stong rar gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ padma'i sna lam ltar phra ba ste/ sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam yar rtse spyi bo dang*/ mar rtse gsang gnas la zug par bsgom/ de je cher gyur nas sba dbyug tsam/ zho dong tsam/ de nas lus thams cad rtsa dbu ma'i rang bzhin du (363)gyur te/ dmar seng nge srab seng de yod pa'i nang du/ yang rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan yar sna spyi bo dang*/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug par bsgoms pa'i mar sna ru rig pa hril gtad la ma yengs par bsgom mo// sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi ni gsum ste/ dang po lus gnad ni/ 'khrul 'khor me thab drug 'ching bya ste/ rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol te/ rkang pa g.yas phyi g.yon nang du bcug la bsnol ba'i g.yon pa'i rting pas bshang gcig gnyis kyi bar them par bltem/ lag pa zhags pa ltar bsdam ste/ mthe bong g.yon pa g.yas kyi gung mos bsnol ba'i mthe ba snying gnyis sbyar ba g.yas pa'i mdzub mo bzhis bsdams/ de'i phyi nas g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bzhis dam du bsdams pa de lta bu'i phyag rgya lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du bca'/ mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar bkug ste mgrin pa rang sar ol mdud pa la char sbyar/ sked pa mda' ltar drang por bsrang*/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyang ste grang mdun du dengs bya/ lus sems li ri ltar bsgrim ste sgom thag rab gnas dang ldan pas dam lhod ran par bsdam mo// de nas rlung lam bsal ba ni/ 'bud pa dgu phrugs te/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du drag la yun ring ba gsum 'bud/ ro stod gcu zhing drag la thung ba gsum 'bud/ 'jam la ring ba gsum 'bud do// rlung rang gnas su bzung ba ni/ kha nas ma song bar phyi nas sna sgo'i nang na mar rlung 'jam la ring ba drangs la/ de'i shugs rdzogs pa dang*/

mchil ma dang sbrags te mid nas lte 'og tu ldig rtser bskyur/ de nas mar rtsir mi mnan par ro stod seng gsang la so ma bag tsam bzhag /de nas 'og rlung g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum du theng gsum (364)'then/ rgyu zhabs so la bzhag /de nas gzhil ba ni/ rlung mi thub la khad pa dang*/ gong bzhin du bskyar la rngubs nas mnan te mi thub pa dang rlung lhag ma ma lus par phyir sangs 'bud de/ gtong dus lte ba nang du cung zad 'then la sna nas thog mar nud tsam la/ de nas shugs yod tshad kyis 'bud de dag la yun ring ba nar tser 'bud do// dmigs pa lte 'og tu gtad do// de la bar rlung rgyu ru mi gzhug par phyir gnas tshad bzhag /phyir mi gnas pa dang sngar bzhin nang du rngubs la rlung sbyor de rnams tshang bar g.yas su gcig /rgyag tu gcig /g.yon du gcig /mdun du gcig ste bzhi bskor gcig go /de lta bu'i rlung bzhi skor re la ngal mi gso bar bya'o// dmigs pa sems kyi gtad pa ni gsum ste/ me'i dmigs pa/ thig le'i dmigs pa/ rlung 'od gsal du gzhug pa gsum/ dang po la rtsa gsal btab pa dang*/ me dmigs sgom pa'o// rtsa la yang rtsa gsum gsal gdab pa dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ lus yi dam du gsal ba'i lus kyi stong ra dang*/ rtsa'i stong ra gnyis kyi nang du dbus na yar rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan yar sna spyi gtsug dang mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon du rkyang ma ste/ rtsa gnyis kyi yar sna sna bug gnyis su zug nas yar spyi bor song*/ de mar gugs te lte 'og tu dbu mar tshud la khad la rtsa gsum gyi 'dzoms yi ge cha'i 'phongs bzhin du yod pa/ mi sgom tsa na kha dog ser po/ bsgoms pas kha dog dmar por song bar bsam mo// gnyis pa 'khor lo bzhi ni/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo na rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na rtsa 'dab bcu drug (365)snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab brgyad/

lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi bsgom te/ 'khor lo bzhi po de gdugs bub pa'i rtsib ma bzhin du shab pe yod pa/ rtsa gsum po gdugs kyi yu ba bzhin du yod pa/ mi sgom dus kha dog ser po/ sgom dus dmar po bsam mo/ rlung rngubs pas ro rkyang gnyis na mar lug rdzud kyi rgyu ma phus btab pa bzhin song nas/ dbu ma'i mar snar sibs sib bus pas/ rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi dmar hur re song ba la dmigs pa gtad do// me dmigs sgom pa ni/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi/ rtsa gsum 'dzom par ma las thob pa'i rakta'i dwangs ma a shad kyi rnam pa skyer pa'i tsher ma lta bu ring thung sor gcig pa/ rtse mo shin tu phra ba thur du bstan pa/ rtsa ba sbom pa gyen du phyogs pa'i sne mo dbu ma'i nang du tshud tsam du bsam/ spyi bo'i dbu ma'i nang du haṃ yig dkar po gsal btab/ de nas rlung rngubs pas rlung ro rkyang gnyis nas song*/ a thung la sibs sib bus pas/ a thung me'i rang bzhin du dmar lhing song ba de nyid tsha ba tshig pa ngar dang ldan par bsam/ a shad la bus pas me hur tser 'bar la khad pa la rig pa ma yengs par gtad/ yang a thung la steng 'og gi rlung gis bus pa a thung gi yar sna las me sor gcig dbu ma'i nang du 'bar bas/ a thung gi yar sna phra nar song bas nas kyi dbyibs lta bu dkyil ldir ba stod smad phra ba la/ me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan me'i rang bzhin du tsha ba/ tshig pa/ ngar dang bcas pa rlung gi rang bzhin du g.yo ba/ rtse mo rno ba/ kha dog dmar por sgom mo/ yang me lce de ring du song nas sor bzhi tsam 'bar bas lte ba'i rtsa mdud la me lce reg yod pa tsam bsgom/ de nas rang gi lus yi dam du yod pa'i sked man chad je ring la song nas sa 'og na mar song bas/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la 'phongs 'og gi gdan lhan (366)tser 'byar ba'i lte 'og gi a thung las me 'bar bas dbu ma'i nang na yar je ring je ring la snying ga'i rtsa mdud la me lce reg reg yod par bsgom/

de nas yang me je ring la mgrin par sleb bar bsgom/ de thams cad la me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'bar ba'i me'i rtsa ba a shad la rig pa gtad pa gal che'o// thig le'i dmigs pa la gnyis te 'bar 'dzag sgom pa dang bogs 'don pa'o// dang po la gsum/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i 'bar 'dzag dang*/ 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa'i 'bar 'dzag /tsa na lī'i 'bar 'dzag go /dang po ni/ me shin tu tsha ba dbu ma na yar song*/ snying kha dang mgrin pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi snyigs ma thams cad bsregs/ de nas me'i 'od kyis spyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun pas khams dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems haṃ yig dngul chu'i mdog lha bu cog sgong tsam skya mer re yod pa de mer tser bzhu bas thigs la khad pa la dmigs pa gtad/ de yang mer zhu nas nar byung bas/ haṃ gi dbyibs mgo bo thur la bstan pa thigs la khad pa la dmigs pa gtad do// de nas me'i drod kyis thigs la khad pa de mer zhu nas skya nar nar byung bas spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab thams cad khrig mer gang bar bsgom/ yang spyi bo nas thig le skya nar byung me lce thung hril song*/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab gang*/ mes yar phul thig les mar mnan pas ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad thig les gang bas bde mer re yod par bsam/ de bzhin du snying kha dang lte ba'i rtsa 'dab rnams kyang gong bzhin bsgom/ de nas thig le lte 'og nas mar babs pas/ me je thung la a shad la lhan song bas spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad khams dkar dmar gyis gang*/ lus mgo zhabs med pa bde mer song bar bsgom/ thig le bsrung dka' zhing (367)drod chung na/ a thung las me sor bzhi'am snying kha dang mgrin pa'i bar du 'bar ba bde nyams dang bstun te/ me des lte ba yan chad kyi thig le rnams yar lte ba snying kha/ mgrin pa spyi bo rnams gang 'dod kyi gnas su bskyal nas mar 'bab tu mi ster/ thig les me de 'og tu mnan nas yar 'bar du mi ster bar bsam/

'dzag pa ma chod na spyi bo'i haṃ gyen la bzhengs par bsgom/ thig le thams cad haṃ la bstims nas haṃ me lce'i rtse mos khyer te spyi bo nas me sor bzhi gyen du 'bar ba'i rtse mo la haṃ yer re yod par bsgom/ bde ba chung na sngar bzhin du thig le mar dbab po// 'khor lo gnyis la bsten pa ni/ me mgrin par slebs pa'i 'od kyis thig le rgyun ma chad par a thung la phog /lus bde bas gang*/ me yar 'bar/ thig le mar babs bas khams dkar dmar rgyun ma chad pa na re yod par bsgom/ rtsa na lī'i 'bar 'dzag ni/ dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bsgom ste/ de nas a thung las me 'bar bas dbu ma na yar song bas rtsa thams cad kyi nang na yar me dmar shig shig 'bar bas haṃ zhu nas thig le yang rtsa nang thams cad du song bas/ rtsa re re'i nang du 'bar 'dzag rgyun mi chad du yod par bsgom mo// bogs 'don pa la gnyis te/ drod dang bde ba la'o// dang po ni/ gtsubs shing ma me'i 'khor lo 'di bya ste/ rlung lam 'bud pa dgus bsal la/ rang gi lus yi dam lhan skyes he ru ka nang stong ra'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi bsgom/ dbu ma las gyes pa'i khrag 'bab pa'i rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis gtor sku la rgyang bu btsugs pa bzhin du bsam/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lor haṃ yig bde ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lor (368)a shad drod kyi rang bzhin du bsam/ lus gnad tsog pu re mig ltar bsnol/ rkang pa'i mtheb chen gnyis la me rtsa thur gyu ba'i ri re re yod par bsams la lag pas bzung*/ steng 'og gi rlung gis raṃ las me 'bar ba rkang dar gyi nang nas zhugs pas a shad la me 'bar/ dbu ma'i nang na yar zhugs/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis las gyes pa'i rtsa re re'i nang du yang me cher 'bar nas/ khams mar 'dzag pa'i dkar dmar du shig shig /'bar 'dzag duṃ 'ur 'ung 'bar bar bsgoms la/

g.yas g.yon gnyis drag tu sprugs shing*/ rlung 'bud khar bcag sprugs la 'bud do// rlung gi gnad ni sbyor ba bzhi ldan bya'o// rjes thams cad du rang lus me ru 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ bza' btung dang gos sogs kyang me ru byin gyis brlab/ snang ba thams cad mer 'bar bar bsgom mo// gnyis pa bde ba'i bogs 'don ni/ thig le zhal sbyor/ steng 'og gi bde ba sgom pa/ ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa sogs zhib par ni gtum mo'i khrid yig rgyas par lta'o// nyams len mdor bsdus ni/ mdun du yid rig gsal la/ lus gnad me thab drug 'ching*/ rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan/ sems gnad rang nyid lhan skyes he ru kar gsal ba'i stong ra dar zab sngon po'i gur phub pa lta bu'i lus kyi nang du rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab/ spyi bor haṃ dang*/ a shad sngar bzhin bsgom/ rlung gis a shad las me sbar/ me'i drod kyis haṃ yig zhu ba'i thigs pa lhung*/ a shad la phog pas me lce mar thur du song*/ slar de las kyang cher 'bar bas lte bar slebs/ haṃ yig cher zhu ba'i thigs pa phog pas mar bros pa ltar song*/ yang de las cher 'bar/ me lce snying khar slebs/ mgrin pa dang spyi bor song*/ (369)haṃ yig chil gyis bzhu ba'i rgyun mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' ba'i bde ba dang*/ snying kha'i rtsa 'khor gang bas mchog dga' dang*/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral dang*/ gsang gnas kyi sna rtse'i mthar thug par babs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i nyams dran par bya zhing*/ de ltar phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas 'dzag med du bzung bas lte ba snying kha mgrin pa spyi bo gang ba dga' ba nas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i bar ngos bzung bar bya'o// rlung 'od gsal du gzhug pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms nas bde drod zhen med du phyag rgya chen por skyel ba dang*/ rig rlung 'od gsal du gzhug pa/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar la sems a shad la cung zad gtad la/

bsam du med pa'i ngang la dran pa mi yengs bar bde ba'i ngo bo la blta bar bya'o// rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs bsal ba la/ spyod lam dang gegs bsal ba'o// dang po ni/ gtum mo sgom dus 'grangs ches pa/ ltogs ches pa mi bya/ me dang nyi ma mi 'de/ rkang rjen chu brgal ba g.yer ma sga dang chang skyur sha rul za chod sogs sngo ngad ri sgog nya sha sogs spang*/ rdul thon pa'i las mi bya/ dus thams cad du 'khrul 'khor drang sing ba bya// zas za ba nyal ldangs gang byed kyang rlung ro 'bud/ phrug dang skyi chags grib can gyi gos rnams mi gyon/ lus sbyong dang mar nag gi bsku byug bya'o// gegs bsal ba ni/ sngar gyi gegs sel bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod sogs yig cha rnams su rgyas par bshad pa las shes par bya'o// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni gnyis te/ yon tan skye tshul dang 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ gtum mo la dus gsum yod de/ gtum mo duḥkha'i dus/ gtum mo 'dod chags kyi dus gtum mo yon tan gyi dus dang gsum yod pas de (370)rnams kyi rnam dbye rgyas par gzhung khrid chen mor zhib par yod do// 'od gsal ni/ lus gnang rlung gnad dmigs pa'i gnad gsum// dang po ni/ mal mgo byang du bstan/ kha nub g.yas 'og gi 'gram 'og tu lag pa bcug /g.yon dpyi la bkab// gnyis pa ni/ lus yi dam lhan skyes bsgom/ snying padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du/ bla ma chos sku'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab/ rlung drag po zhig rngubs la thub tshad bzung*/ mig gyen la bgrad/ rig pa snying khar gtad/ rlung bum can bdun yan chad bsgom// gsum pa ni/ snying kha'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bha san ta kha bye ba'i steng du padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lus kyi nang khrol sogs mi gtsang ba dang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/

stong sangs song*/ lus nang thams cad hūm̐ 'od kyis skya lam me song bar bsam/ de nas gnyid song ma thag 'od gsal 'char ba ngo shes par bya snyam pa'i bdun pa btang*/ hūm̐ la rig pa gtad phyag rgya chen po la bzhag /de'i ngang nas gnyid la thim song ba dang gsal stong nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu zhig yer 'char/ yang hūm̐ gi tshab 'od sngon po cog sgong tsam la dmigs pa gtad/ yang snying dbus su bla ma'i sku chung la rdzogs pa zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po nas tsam zhig sgom pa gong bzhin bya zhing*/ de'i ngo bo la sems gtad nas gnyid log pas/ mthong snang sna tshogs su 'byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ lung pa dang yul khams dang*/ tha ma yang rang gi spyil po'i nang na gang yod mthong bar 'gyur ro// tshe 'dir sbyong long byung na btson 'grus can tshe 'dir sangs rgyas la/ sbyong (371)long ma byung na 'chi kha'i bar do dang lam goms pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ 'od gsal gnyis chu la chu blugs pa bzhin du 'dres nas 'chi ba chos sku'i zhing khams su sangs rgya'o// sgyu lus ni/ rang gi mgrin par bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ snod sgyu mar sbyang ba dang*/ bcud sgyu mar sbyang ba dang*/ 'jig rten chos brgyad sgyu mar sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ ngo bo la bltas na bden par skad cig kyang ma grub/ 'khrul ngo na sna tshogs su snang gi 'dug pas mi bden bzhin du snang ba 'di dang*/ drod gsher dang sa bon las myu gu skyes/ yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu smin nas nam zla dus kyis brul cing*/ dbyar zhu dgun 'khyag rim gyis 'gyur 'gro/ ngo bo la bltas pas bden par ma grub/ lho 'dzam bu gling pa'i dgun la byang sgra mi snyan pa'i dbyar byed/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i nyi ma phyed la/ sgra mi snyan pa'i nam phyed byed/ dpe lo dang nyin mtshan skyid sdug la 'gro/ gling bzhi ka'i nyi ma 'char nub la phyogs 'dzin par 'dug ge// gcig gi shar la gcig gi nub/

gcig steng la gcig gi 'og byed de bzhin kun la 'gro/ ngo bo la bltas pas bden par skad cig kyang ma grub/ 'khrul ngo na sna tshogs su snang gin 'dug pas/ zhen med du snang ba 'di sgyu lus kyi nyams len yin no// gnyis pa bcud sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang lus dang gzhan lus gnyis ka'i spyod pa sgyu mar sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung po 'di/ bar do'i rnam shes dang*/ pha ma'i khu khrag 'dzoms pa las byung zhing*/ rten 'brel tshogs pa'i rdzun snang gi lus la so so la ming re dum bur bsil na lus gzhi ma grub// gnyis pa ni/ ma'i mngal du chags nas rga shi'i bar rim gyis 'gyur 'gro/ rang gi sems thog tu bde (372)sdug ci shar kyang*/ skad cig re yang tshugs mi thub pas/ ngo bo la bltas pas bden par ma grub// gsum pa gnyis ka'i spyod pa sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ khyim thabs byed pa dang*/ lus la bu tsha byung ba dang*/ skyes pa sogs la ngo mi tsha bar/ pho mtshan dang mo mtshan la ngo tshar phyed/ ngo bo la bltas pas bden par ma grub bo// 'jig rten chos brgyad sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ stod smad bde sdug snyan mi snyan dang*/ grags ma grags brjod pa la grub pa 'dug mi 'dug blta/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang gi rgyab tu yi dam lha'i bris sku bkram la/ mdun du me long g.ya' med bzhag par gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ rim gyis bag chags sbyangs shing*/ mthar snod bcud thams cad yi dam du bsgoms la sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas smon lam btab/ rdzogs rim sgyu ma ni/ sems 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad cing ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da lta bar bzo ma byas par ma yengs par bar snang stong sang nge ba la rtse gcig tu bltas pas/ rlung sems dbu mar tshud/ rnam rtog zhi nas du ba dang smig rgyu dang me 'khyer dang sgron ma'am skya rengs dang*/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu la sogs pa'i nyams kyi snang ba chu zla'am/

me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar dwangs shing gsal la sgrib pa med pa mtshan dpe ldan pa'i sprul pa'i sku mthong zhing*/ de nas sgrar snang ba'i longs sku 'byung ngo*// gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ mnyam bzhag brtan pa dang*/ rjes shes kyi snang ba'i steng du stong gzugs drangs nas bltas pas/ 'khor 'das la sogs pa'i gnyis su snang ba'i chos thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kun rdzob kyi bden pa sgyu ma'i ting nge 'dzin du 'char zhing*/ de nyid la mnyam par bzhag (373)pas 'od gsal du dag par 'gyur ro// rmi lam ni/ nyin par gyi dus su 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug ci byed kyang*/ rmi lam yin zer ba ngag tu yang brjod cing*/ gnyid log pa'i dus su mgrin par a dmar po la sems gtad nas/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par bya'o snyams pa'i ngang nas rmi lam zin pa dang*/ khyi zhig byung yang de bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhar gyur nas/ de la dbang chos zhus sangs rgyas kyi zhing du phyin nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la blta zhing*/ rang gang 'dod pa'i zhing la blta bar bya'o// rmi lam gyi ngang la phyag rgya chen po la bzhag pas mngon du 'gyur ro// 'pho ba ni/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun byas la/ rang lus yi dam lhan skyes he ru ka// nang stong rar gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug 'bring po tsam yar rtse spyi gtsug tu kha dang nge yod pa/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa kha dog dmar po/ spyi bo khru gang ba'i nam mkha' la gu ru dhā dza shrī bha dra rab byung gi cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i mthar chos drug brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsgom/ lte 'og sor bzhir dbu ma'i nang du rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar po sha ba'i ril ma tsam zhig gi dbus na hūm̐ dmar po nas 'bru tsam zhig bsgom/

de gsal thebs pa na/ ngag tu hi gces brjod pas/ thig le de spyi gtsug tu thal slebs/ tshangs bug khang pa'i mthong khung ltar skya thal le 'dug par bsam/ yang hi ka ces brjod pas/ tshangs bug nas rgyangs thon/ gyen du mda' 'phangs pa bzhin song*/ gu ru'i thugs khar slebs/ zan khams gcig za yun nas/ ka zhes brjod pas thig le de dal bus tshangs bug nas lte 'og sor zhir phab/(374)yang hig ces pas spyi bor slebs/ yang hi ka brjod pas gu ru'i thugs kar slebs/ ka zhes pas lte 'og tu phab/ de ltar dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas sbyong thebs re la tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig las mi nyung bar bsgom par bya'o// yang tho rangs gnyid sad ma thag /bde ba can nam mngon dga' 'am/ o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing sogs gang du 'gro 'dod pa'i zhing der 'gro dgos snyams pas/ zhing de'i bkod pa yid la dung nge dran par bya zhing*/ zhing khams der phyin nas padma'i steng du dge sbyor byed par bsams la/ sems yun ring du mnyam par bzhag go /de la dmigs skor gcig /yang hig ces brjod pas dbu ma'i nang gi thig le hūm̐ dang bcas pa spyi gtsug nas rgyangs thon/ gu ru'i thugs kar thim pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /ka zhes pas mar lte 'og tu phab/ cung zad bzhag /de la dmigs skor gcig /yang sngar ltar dmigs pa gsal ba'i spyi gtsug khru gang gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gu ru dang dbyer med pa'i zhing khams gang la mos pa'i ston pa dbyer med par bsgom la/ hi ka ces pas theg le spyi gtsug nas byon/ ston pa'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ yang ka zhes pas mar phab pa gong bzhin no// de ltar bsgoms pas rtags su spyi gtsug g.ya' zhing tsha ba/ chu ser thon cing skrangs pa la sogs pa 'byung la/ de rnams ma byung bar bsgom par bya'o// yang sngar bzhin bsgoms pas thig le hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de bla ma'i thugs khar thim pa dang*/ bla ma bde ba can nam mngon dga' sogs su mda' 'phangs pa bzhin song nas 'od dpag med dam mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs khar thim pa la shes pa ma yengs par bsgom thog tu bzhag par bya'o// nyal ba'i dus su shes pa snying kha nas 'thon/

zhing khams gang mos (375)der 'phangs/ rang zhing khams der yod pa'i ngang du gnyid log go /las la sbyar ba ni/ dus la bab pa'i tshe lus gnad tsog pu'am seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ rang lus phyi yi dam nad stong ra rtsa dbu ma sogs gong bzhin gsal btab/ spyi bor bla ma dang gang mos kyi zhing gi ston pa dbyer med du bsgom/ de la skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa gsol 'debs bya/ rang gang 'dod pa'i zhing der 'gro snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po yang yang bya/ rang gi sems thig le dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de dbu ma'i nang nas yar song*/ spyi gtsug nas thon/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim par bsams la rlung phyir 'bud/ mig gyen la bsgreng*/ hi ka drag po lan 'ga' brjod pa'i rting la bla ma de gang du 'gro ba'i zhing de'i sangs rgyas kyi drung du skar mda' 'phang ba bzhin song nas/ de'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo// des don 'grub bo// bar do ni/ 'chi ba'i dus su dbang po phra rags thim pa'i rjes la/ rnam rtog thams cad dang bral ba/ nam mkha'i dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu/ ngo bo stong pa'i gnas lugs ma bcos pa ji lta bu bzhin du der 'char bas/ de 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par shes par byas te/ de'i dus su phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur sangs rgya'o// srid pa bar do'i dus su/ dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu zhing rdzu 'phrul 'od dang ldan pa'i dus shig 'ong ste/ de bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par shes par byas la/ yi dam gyi lha skur gyur par bsgoms pas/ shing bsregs pa'i sol ba de shing du mi ldog pa bzhin/ rlung sems las grub pa'i rgyu mtshan nyid yin pa ste/ yi dam lhar gyur nas (376)bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgya'o// dri za mngal sgo 'tshol ba'i dus/ pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chags sdang skye bas/

pha ma de yi dam yab yum du sgom zhing*/ rang nyid gtum mo'i 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa gtad nas mngal du mi 'jug snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang byas nas/ phyin chad shes bzhin du skye ba len pa zhig yod ste/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes par byas te/ grub thob pho mo sbyor ba byed pa'i mngal du zhugs pas/ skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur sangs rgya'o// de rnams chos drug gi snying po bsdus nas nyams su blangs tshul yin/ kho bos nā ro'i chos drug la yig cha rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum cha lag tshang zhing zab par bris yod cing*/ skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la'ang rang gi myong chos zab mo rnams ma sbas lhug par byin yod pas nyams su blangs shing skal ldan rnams la spel cig /nga shangs sgom rgad po'i myong chos 'di rnams kyi yig cha dbang khrid lung gsum gyi rgyun ni/ nyi 'og thams cad du phyogs dang ris su med par khyab par gyur yod de/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yongs su rdzogs par nyams su len cing 'chad pa dang nyan pa dang sgrub pa ni nyin skar las dkon par 'gyur la/ yig cha rnams kyang gcig tu 'dus par mi 'gyur zhing*/ bla ma 'ba' ra ba zhes pa'i ming rkam po ni skal pa ma stong gi bar du gnas so// dus ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus na/ skyes bu shes rab dang brtson 'grus chung ba/ che 'dod dang nor 'dod che ba/ dad pa dang mos gus chung ba/ 'dod chags dang phrag dog che ba/ bla ma dang chos la yid mi ches shing log lta che ba/ sgrub pa mi nus shing sdug sran chung ba/ sdom pa dang dam tshig khyad du gsod pa/ ci byed kyang sdig dang 'dres pa'i las kho na byed pa'i dus su nga'i myong chos 'di (377)rnams kyang snum zad mar me tsam du 'gro bas/ de dus las dang skal par ldan pa re gnyis 'byung ste/ des tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs zab mo/ nā ro'i chos drug gi gdams ba zab la 'dus pa shin tu bsdus pa 'di nyid nyams su blangs shing spel bar byos shig

/rab rnams kyis thar par 'jug ba'i gru bo che'i rtsa 'grel lhan thabs dang bcas pa la 'chad nyan dang*/ phrin las skor gyi sgrub thabs dbang bskur sogs gang la yang bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang lag len sogs mthar phyin zhing the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod par byas nas/ phyag chen sogs zab khrid mtha' dag la'ang myong khrid lo dang zla ba du mar sbrel nas sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan thon par bya zhing*/ 'bring rnams kyis kyang thar par 'jug pa'i gru bo skor gsum gyi dbang khrid lung gsum thob pa/ khyad par nā ro chos drug dang phyag rgya chen po la rtsal thon pa/ gdams pa 'di skor gyi dbang khrid lung gsum 'chad thub pa bya/ tha mas kyang gdams pa zab bsdus 'di tsam la nyams len gyi snying por bsgril la/ snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul dka' zhing dad pa dang mos gus chung ba'i dus der rtags cha lugs kyang 'dul pa dang mthun pa gtsang sing ba re bgyi/ chags lam gyi nyams len mthar ma phyin par bags med kyi spyod pa dang cha lugs 'dis dmyal bar 'phen pa'i grogs las/ thar lam bgrod pa zhig dka' bas las rgya bsten pa dang lung ma bstan gyi cha lugs ma byed/ dgon gnas 'ba' ra 'di yang dar rgud shin tu mang ba zhig 'byung ste/ skabs skabs su nged rang gi skye ba 'dra yong bar srid cing*/ gdams pa 'di yang rnyed par 'gyur ro// yang na phyogs nges med nas kho bo rang gi rjes su 'jug pa'i skal ldan rigs rus phun sum (378)tshogs pa/ kho bo la lhag par dad pa/ dpa' rtags dpral bar thod skam gyi ri mo yod pa'am/ gdong sme'am/ ro stod la sme ba'i ser la kha'am/ ro stod la stag sham gyi ri mo dod pa yod pa/ blo sna mang zhing byis pa'i spyod pa byed pa/ skabs skabs su lhag pa'i lha'i zhal yud tsam yud tsam mthong ba'i skal ldan zhig gis chos 'di rnyed par 'gyur bas/ 'di rnyed pa na gsang zhing dam par gyis la/ chos 'di'i tshig don blo la chud par byas nas shog dril 'di slar yang smon lam dang gsol ba thob la gnas de nyid du sngar bzhin zhog cig

/sbos shig /'di rnyed pa'i gang zag des chos 'di nyid rnyed nas lo 'ga' song ba na/ snying dang 'dra ba'i bu zhig la gtod la/ dar rgyas yun ring du 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ des nyams su blangs shing spel na/ slob ma las kyang yang slob bzang bar 'byung ngo*// snying gi bu gcig las gzhan la chos 'di'i dpe yang mi ston zhing*/ lung yang mi byed ci'i phyir na dad pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin mi byed pas kun la gsang zhing dam par byed pa ni gnad dam pa'o// 'di'i chos bka' 'byed pa na/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la tshogs gtor rgya chen po phul zhing*/ chos skyong srung ma la skong bshags tshogs gtor/ gnas bdag dge bsnyen pa la gtor ma bsngo zhing bden tshig brjod la/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro la gnang ba zhus nas/ slob ma snying dang 'dra ba zhig la bshad par bya'o// chos 'di'i rgyab chos kho bos brtsams pa'i thar par 'jug pa'i gru bo skor gsum cha lag dang bcas pa'i yig cha thams cad la zhib tu ltos shig /khyad par sgrub pa'i lag len rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba'i bstan bcos la 'ang nan tan tu ltos shig /ma 'ongs pa'i skye 'gro kho bo la dad cing 'dun pa thams cad/ kho bos (379)brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rnams la ltos shig /klogs shig /tshig kha 'don gyis shig /nyams su longs shig /glegs bam du bris shig /phyag dang mchod pa'i rten du gyis shig /don nyams su longs shig /de ltar byas na shangs sgom rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang dngos su 'phrad pa yin no// bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin no// bkra shis bde legs dpal 'bar don 'grub shog /ces pa'i zab chos 'di nyid kho bo dharma'i ming can gyis rang lo so bzhi lon pa/ sa pho stag gi lo hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin shangs 'ba' ra don grub sding nas dngos grub kyi skal par thob nas lo nyi shu rtsa gsum song ba/ rang lo lnga bcu nga drug la slebs pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo hor zla dang po cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin shog dril bu yig las dpe thog tu phab pa 'dis 'gro don nam mkha'i mtha'i bar khyab par gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// grub pa'i skyes mchog chen po'i zhal gdams bla ma sgrub pa'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhugs/ na mo gu ru badzra dha rā ya/ srid zhi'i khyab bdag sku lnga'i dbang phyug gtso// ston mchog bcom ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so smin cing grol ba dang*/ rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sku gsum sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i rol rtsed kyis// bde chen mchog stsol ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// gsol ba 'debs so smin cing = /rnam thar 'khyongs par= /nyams rtogs don brgyud byin rlabs bar ma chad// grub brnyes rgya bod bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs= /rnam thar 'khyongs par= /rgyal ba dngos nyid mkhas grub bshes gnyen tshul// he ru ka dpal skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// gsol ba 'debs (380)so smin cing grol ba dang*// rnam thar 'khyongs par= /dgongs pas byin rlabs zab gter chos bka' bab// bka' drin gsum ldan blo gros chos 'phel zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /rnam thar 'khyongs pa= dam pas rjes bzung smon lam las 'phro can// don brgyud bka' bab rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyi brlab= /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i// thugs rje nus pa gcig bsdus gu ru nyid// skyabs kun snying por sgrub cing gsol ba 'debs// byin rlabs 'pho bas bdag rgyud 'grol du gsol// srid pa'i bde la nam yang mi zhen par// rtse gcig nges don snying po'i lam bsgoms pas// sku gnyis 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob pa dang*// bka' brgyud rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyis brlab// mgon khyod ring lugs rin chen dbang gi rgyal// tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser// mchod pa'i bstan 'dzin dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bas// snying po'i bstan pa rgyas par byin gyi rlobs// khyod gsung zab lam nor bu'i cod pan gang*// ris med mchog dman 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// spyi bor bkod pa'i phrin las rab rgyas pas// nyid kyi ring lugs 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// bslu med dam pa khyed kyi thugs rje'i mthus// bdag kyang sku tshe mdzad phrin spangs rtogs kyi// yon tan khyod sku ci 'dra de thob nas// 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// zhes khyad par gyi bla sgrub brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rang nyid kyi dad pas kun nas bslangs te me 'brug sa ga chen po'i yar tshes dge bar rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang pos gdan sa chen po (381)'ba' rar sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ chos drug bsdus pa'i 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ rnam par 'dren mchog ston pa rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i lcags kyus zung*// rlung sems 'pho ba'i lam mchog 'byongs pa dang*// sku gsum go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zag med bde ster ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i= /rlung sems 'pho ba'i= /sku gsum go 'phang = /rgya bod bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rlung sems 'pho ba'i= /sku gsum go 'phang = /grub pa'i skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rlung sems 'pho ba'i= /sku gsum go 'phang = /zab don bka' babs blo gros chos 'phel la// gsol ba= /rlung sems= /sku gsum= /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /rlung sems= /sku gsum= /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung*// rlung sems 'pho ba'i lam mchog 'byongs pa dang*// sku gsum go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// 'khor ba'i phun tshogs sdug bsngal rang bzhin la// chags med nges 'byung dad pas yid drangs te// rlung sems rtse gcig 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// gtan bde thar pa'i zhing mchog bgrod par shog /btsan thabs 'pho ba zab mo'i lam mchog gis// sgrib gnyis rang dag sa lam mthar phyin te// skye med 'od gsal chos sku mngon gyur nas// gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don spyod shog /ces chos drug bsdus pa'i 'pho (382)ba'i gsol 'debs 'di yang ngag dbang ye shes kyis rang dang skal mnyam gyi slob ma dag la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis bde chen 'ba' rar sbyar ba dge'o/// /
